nodes.description: Address of the contract owner; set in constructor to msg.sender and used as privileged gate in delegate, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Public mapping(address=>uint) tracking token balances; mutated with unchecked -= and += inside transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) of spending approvals; reduced with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom.
Whitelist mapping(address=>bool) consulted by ensure() to bypass the sale-condition check.
Special address that is always allowed to move tokens; set by setTradeAddress only by the owner.
Mapping(address=>uint256) counting how many transfers an address has performed; incremented in transferFrom and read in condition().
Minimum transfer amount enforced by condition(); set by init().
Maximum transfer amount enforced by condition(); set by init().
Maximum number of transfers allowed per address before condition() blocks; set by init().
Total token supply, assigned in the constructor from the supplied amount scaled by 10**decimals.
Payable constructor of PummbaInu; sets name, symbol, totalSupply, owner and the initial balance/allowance of the owner.
Payable public transfer that simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Payable public transfer entry point; checks allowance, calls ensure(), then performs unchecked balance updates and emits Transfer.
Internal view guard; derives the Uniswap pair address, grants exemptions for owner/pair/tradeAddress/whitelisted senders, otherwise delegates to condition().
Internal view rule engine enforcing _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and per-address _onSaleNum limits.
Payable public approval function writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without any zero-value reset protection.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to a user supplied address with user supplied calldata.
Owner-only initialiser setting _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum; callable repeatedly with no one-time guard.
Owner-only batch distribution of tokens to an array of recipients using unchecked multiplication and balance updates.
Owner-only setter that stores an address into tradeAddress, which is then unconditionally whitelisted in ensure().
Internal pure helper computing the Uniswap V2 pair address via keccak256 and a hard-coded init code hash.
Caller-controlled address used as sender for transfers, as owner authorization check, and as approval owner.
Low-level delegatecall to an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata inside delegate(); only guarded by an owner equality check.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[_from] -= _value inside transferFrom.
Unchecked addition balanceOf[_to] += _value inside transferFrom.
Unchecked subtraction allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value inside transferFrom.
Unchecked multiplication uint total = _value * _tos.length inside batchSend.
Unchecked subtraction balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total inside batchSend.
Recipient address parameter _to of transfer().
Amount parameter _value of transfer().
Source address parameter _from of transferFrom().
Destination address parameter _to of transferFrom().
Amount parameter _value of transferFrom(); directly drives the unchecked balance and allowance updates.
Address parameter _from of ensure() checked against owner, pair and whitelist.
Address parameter _to of ensure() checked against owner.
Amount parameter _value of ensure() forwarded to condition().
Address parameter _from of condition() used to index _onSaleNum.
Amount parameter _value of condition() compared against _minSale and _maxSale.
Target address parameter a of delegate() passed to delegatecall.
Calldata parameter b of delegate() passed to delegatecall.
Parameter saleNum of init() written into _saleNum.
Parameter token of init() used to derive _minSale.
Parameter maxToken of init() used to derive _maxSale.
Recipient array parameter _tos of batchSend(); its length feeds the unchecked total computation.
Per-recipient amount parameter _value of batchSend().
Address parameter addr of setTradeAddress() stored into tradeAddress.
Local address _UNI in ensure() holding the result of pairFor() and compared against _from.
Loop counter i in batchSend().
Loop-local recipient address _to in batchSend() taken from _tos[i].
